reader_summary.headline: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast. I'm DOS, and in today's episode, Jason Warner, the CTO of GitHub, talks with A16Z general partner, David Ullovich. Shelter and place orders have more companies making the move to remote faster than ever, so is this our new normal.

key_points.text: I'm DOS, and in today's episode, Jason Warner, the CTO of GitHub, talks with A16Z general partner, David Ullovich.
key_points.evidence_quote: I'm DOS, and in today's episode, Jason Warner, the CTO of GitHub, talks with A16Z general partner, David Ullovich, about the best and worst practices of remote development, and more broadly, remote work.

key_points.text: Shelter and place orders have more companies making the move to remote faster than ever, so is this our new normal.
key_points.evidence_quote: Shelter and place orders have more companies making the move to remote faster than ever, so is this our new normal, and is it the future of work?

key_points.text: In this hallway-style jam, the two discuss the tools and strategies for communication and alignment, what does and doesn't work.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this hallway-style jam, the two discuss the tools and strategies for communication and alignment, what does and doesn't work, from demos to burn down charts, and end on some reflections given the current crisis.

key_points.text: They begin, however, by talking about where location does, or maybe we should say, doesn't come in.
